items.text: José e Carlos regalano un biscotto alla bambina.
items.translation: José and Carlos give the girl a cookie.

source.name: youtube
source.title: En el parque — Spanish Learning Mini Story (A2) #LearnSpanish #Spanish

items.text: La bambina sorride e se ne va con il suo cane.
items.translation: The girl smiles and leaves with her dog.

source.name: youtube
source.title: En el parque — Spanish Learning Mini Story (A2) #LearnSpanish #Spanish

items.text: José e Carlos continuano a giocare.
items.translation: José and Carlos keep playing.

source.name: youtube
source.title: En el parque — Spanish Learning Mini Story (A2) #LearnSpanish #Spanish

items.text: Cominciano a giocare con un gioco di carte.
items.translation: They start playing a card game.

source.name: youtube
source.title: En el parque — Spanish Learning Mini Story (A2) #LearnSpanish #Spanish

items.text: Un adulto si avvicina a loro. Chiede se hanno bisogno di aiuto.
items.translation: An adult comes over to them. He asks if they need help.

source.name: youtube
source.title: En el parque — Spanish Learning Mini Story (A2) #LearnSpanish #Spanish

items.text: José e Carlos lo ringraziano, ma continuano a giocare.
items.translation: José and Carlos thank him but keep playing.

source.name: youtube
source.title: En el parque — Spanish Learning Mini Story (A2) #LearnSpanish #Spanish

items.text: Il sole torna a splendere. Il parco è pieno di gente.
items.translation: The sun comes out again. The park is full of people.

source.name: youtube
source.title: En el parque — Spanish Learning Mini Story (A2) #LearnSpanish #Spanish

items.text: José e Carlos si salutano. Promettono di tornare presto.
items.translation: José and Carlos say goodbye. They promise to come back soon.

source.name: youtube
source.title: En el parque — Spanish Learning Mini Story (A2) #LearnSpanish #Spanish

items.text: Ora, alcune domande sulla storia.
items.translation: Now, some questions about the story.

source.name: youtube
source.title: En el parque — Spanish Learning Mini Story (A2) #LearnSpanish #Spanish

items.text: Dov'è José all'inizio della storia?
items.translation: Where is José at the beginning of the story?

source.name: youtube
source.title: En el parque — Spanish Learning Mini Story (A2) #LearnSpanish #Spanish

items.text: Nel parco. José aspetta il suo amico Carlos nel parco.
items.translation: In the park. José is waiting for his friend Carlos in the park.

source.name: youtube
source.title: En el parque — Spanish Learning Mini Story (A2) #LearnSpanish #Spanish

items.text: Cosa fa José dopo aver chiesto in prestito il pallone?
items.translation: What does José do after borrowing the ball?

source.name: youtube
source.title: En el parque — Spanish Learning Mini Story (A2) #LearnSpanish #Spanish

items.text: Comincia a giocare con il pallone. José comincia a giocare con il pallone dopo averlo chiesto in prestito al ragazzo.
items.translation: He starts playing with the ball. José starts playing with the ball after borrowing it from the boy.

source.name: youtube
source.title: En el parque — Spanish Learning Mini Story (A2) #LearnSpanish #Spanish

items.text: Perché José si siede su una panchina?
items.translation: Why does José sit on a bench?

source.name: youtube
source.title: En el parque — Spanish Learning Mini Story (A2) #LearnSpanish #Spanish

items.text: Ha freddo. José si siede su una panchina perché ha freddo.
items.translation: He feels cold. José sits on a bench because he feels cold.

source.name: youtube
source.title: En el parque — Spanish Learning Mini Story (A2) #LearnSpanish #Spanish

items.text: Cosa fanno José e Carlos alla fine della storia?
items.translation: What do José and Carlos do at the end of the story?

source.name: youtube
source.title: En el parque — Spanish Learning Mini Story (A2) #LearnSpanish #Spanish

items.text: Si salutano. José e Carlos si salutano alla fine della storia.
items.translation: They say goodbye. José and Carlos say goodbye at the end of the story.
